guide: A question mark marks an item awaiting your answer, a check one already decided. Every decision carries my recommendation in a green frame. The riskiest items are flagged yellow, so read those first when time is short. The answer box at the end holds text you can copy and paste into the conversation. Explain on any item copies a question about it, to paste into the conversation when something is unclear.
answer_help: The options above start on my recommendations. Change any you disagree with, then copy this text into the conversation.

js.copy_fallback: Text selected. Copy it with the menu or a keyboard shortcut.
js.nav_keys: Keys: j next · k previous · o fold or open
js.explain_placeholder: e.g. what does option B change for me?
js.explain_copied: Prompt copied. Paste it into the conversation.
js.explain_hint: Paste it into the conversation; your choices on this page stay as they are.
js.explain_default: Explain this in plain words: what it means, why it matters, and what each option changes.
